summary: Helm cascade retries now become terminal when they reach the bounded failure counter, preserving the database constraint and retained-database upgrades. Argo observation recovers safely when an exact desired-state Application is recreated with a new UID. Source builds default to the running Kuberploy CPU architecture while multi-platform remains opt-in, and Git SSH builds include a pinned OpenSSH client. The pre-stable schema remains one 001_initial migration.
